agent.name: Devin
agent.fusion_lock_method: Use the exact non-Fusion model ID swe-2-medium; reject all fusion-* model IDs. The installed CLI exposes no separate --fusion flag.

billing_evidence.observed_label: Both swe-2-medium and swe-2-max were displayed with [Free].
billing_evidence.interpretation: CLI display evidence only; promotional period, plan terms, quota, and final account billing were not independently verified.
billing_evidence.safeguard: Retain --confirm-paid until the operator confirms the account-side cost treatment.

allowed: environment or authentication correction unrelated to the bug
infrastructure recovery if the harness fails
not_allowed: telling Devin why a patch is wrong
intervention_policy.logging: Every allowed intervention is recorded with timestamp, reason, and operator action.

scoring.task_success: Hidden evaluator tests pass and public tests remain passing.
scoring.regressions: Any unrelated test regression is recorded and makes regression_status=regression.
scoring.patch_scope: Record changed files and added/deleted lines; compare with the reference only after the session is closed.
scoring.inconclusive: Environment failure, timeout, or unavailable evaluator is not scored as an agent success.
